name: Anthropic
description: San Francisco safety-first lab behind the Claude family, Claude Code and Constitutional AI.
longDescription: Anthropic was founded by former OpenAI researchers with a charter centered on safety research, interpretability and a more cautious deployment curve. Claude became the default enterprise alternative to ChatGPT, later expanding into Claude Code and computer-use agents. Amazon and Google are the principal strategic investors.
